nodes.notes: Called by ringcentral-subscription-renew.json's fallback node with reason=renewal-fallback.

nodes.name: Create Subscription

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ eventFilters: [$json.eventFilter], deliveryMode: { transportType: $json.transportType, address: $json.webhookUrl }, expiresIn: $json.expiresIn }) }}

oAuth2Api.name: RingCentral OAuth2 (reuse existing send/receive credential — do NOT create a second one)

nodes.notes: TODO(Alan): confirm the RC app has the subscription-webhook scope enabled, not just SMS send/receive — this call 403s without it. Requires the handshake code (ringcentral-webhook-handshake-snippet.js) to already be live in the receive handler.

nodes.name: Persist Subscription ID
nodes.notes: Persistence = n8n workflow static data (single-subscription/single-number scope, per doc recommendation). Revisit as a DB row if Axiom scales to multiple numbers/accounts.

nodes.name: Notify Success (Gmail Draft)

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.fallbackRecovery ? 'RingCentral subscription RECOVERED (renewal fallback fired)' : 'RingCentral subscription registered' }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'Subscription ID: ' + $json.subscriptionId + '
Expires: ' + $json.expirationTime + '
Created: ' + $json.creationTime + '

' + ($json.fallbackRecovery ? 'This was NOT a fresh deploy — the daily renewal workflow could not renew the existing subscription and had to re-register from scratch. Something upstream is wrong even though it self-healed; worth checking why renewal failed.' : 'Fresh registration, initiated manually or via deploy.') }}

nodes.notes: Matches the Gmail-draft notification pattern already used by content-log.md / prospecting-log.md automations.

parameters.subject: RingCentral subscription registration FAILED
parameters.message:
={{ 'Status: ' + $json.statusCode + '
Body: ' + JSON.stringify($json.errorBody) + '

Likely cause: ' + ($json.statusCode === 403 ? 'missing subscription-webhook scope on the RC app' : ($json.statusCode === 400 ? 'malformed event filter or body' : 'handshake not implemented/live yet in the receive handler, or webhookUrl misconfigured')) + (
$json.fallbackRecovery ? '

This fired from the daily renewal workflow's fallback path — the subscription is currently NOT active. SMS will silently stop arriving until this is fixed.' : '') }}
